nodes.description: Brand assets: main icon, screen-specific logos (login, register, activate, forgot-reset), and feature icons (modules, quiz, pre-test, post-test, references, video).

nodes.label: Multi-Platform Flutter Build
nodes.description: Built for Android (primary), iOS, Linux, macOS, Windows, and Web via Flutter's multi-platform toolchain.

nodes.label: Stunting Education Mission
nodes.description: Core app purpose: educate Indonesian mothers about stunting prevention, maternal nutrition, and infant health through structured modules, assessments, and journaling.

nodes.label: Firebase Integration
nodes.description: Firebase Core and Firebase Cloud Messaging for push notifications to mothers and nurses.

nodes.label: Generasi Emas App
nodes.description: Flutter mobile app for maternal health education and stunting prevention (Partisipasi Ibu & Edukasi Stunting). Targets Indonesian mothers (patients) and healthcare nurses.
